falsifier_requirement.trigger: FDC source snapshot hash is missing or changes during replay; nutrient number 307 appears in visible model or comparator inputs; visible ash nutrient 207 or calcium nutrient 301 is missing; N is below 20; target-hidden task table, hidden target lock, scoring pack, or replay hash is missing or changes during replay; sodium shuffle negative control is not rejected

incumbent_comparator.baseline_name: FoodData Central visible calcium mineral baseline
incumbent_comparator.prediction_rule: predict sodium_mg_per_100g = visible calcium_mg_per_100g from nutrient 301
incumbent_comparator.required_material_margin: model residual must beat comparator residual under the declared domain-local metric

no_fake_closure_policy: Negative source-bound scoring remains a scientific blocker; it cannot be counted as broad superiority.
pass_predicate: pack_status == PASS, material_margin_met == true, no fail-closed status, replay_record PASS.
repair_strategy: If negative, improve the source-bound model/comparator route from canonical evidence rather than weakening the materiality rule.

residual_requirement.formula: absolute sodium residual in mg per 100 g; aggregate MAE across heldout FDC food rows
residual_requirement.superiority_rule: model_MAE must beat comparator_MAE by a material predeclared margin and every negative control must be rejected; this work order does not permit coverage closure from the compact scorer alone

residuals.material_margin_rule: source-bound materialized evidence pack must show OC residual strictly below preregistered comparator residual under the declared uncertainty rule

target_variable.extraction_rule: Target values remain hidden until scoring according to the domain-local work order.
target_variable.name: heldout_food_sodium_content

uncertainty_requirement.metric: absolute sodium residual in mg per 100 g; aggregate MAE across heldout FDC food rows
uncertainty_requirement.rule: deterministic jackknife interval over row-level absolute sodium residuals after prediction materialization

why_it_failed: Existing executable evidence pack passes strict material superiority predicates.
